verses.1: For behold, the Lord God has brought forth His armies from Jerusalem and from Judah. All those who are used to making bread, as well as all those who are used to making wine, have been brought forth from there.
verses.2: A ruler and a warrior who judges, a prophet, a magician, and an elder.
verses.3: A man of fifty years old, with a kind and gentle face; wise and insightful, and able to read people’s thoughts.
verses.4: And I will give them young men, and they will rule over them.
verses.5: And the people would attack each other, one person against another. The young man would attack the old man, and the young woman would attack her husband.
verses.6: If one person is slandered by his brother in his father’s house, then he will become a traitor. Such a treachery will fall into your hands.
verses.7: On that day, he will say, “There will be no bread in my house. There is no cloth to cover me with. I shall not be able to find any one to take care of me.”
verses.8: For when Jerusalem and Judah fell, they became a source of shame and disgrace. They were exposed to God’s judgment.
verses.9: Their knowledge of their own faces made them ashamed. Their sins were as ugly as the sun. They did not confess them to each other, nor did they tell each other about their sins. They acted like they had done nothing wrong.
verses.10: Say, “The righteous are good; they will enjoy what is good and fruitful.”
verses.11: Oh, how evil is that wicked man! His hands will be turned into tools of destruction.
verses.12: My people are being oppressed, and women are being treated unfairly. My people are being deceived, and their paths are blocked.
verses.13: He stands to fight against Jehovah, and he stands to judge the nations.
verses.14: The LORD will come with His judgment, along with the elders of His people and their leaders. And you, who live in your cities, are like thieves who steal from the poor in your own towns.
verses.15: What will you do to my people? Our faces will be turned into the faces of the poor. O Lord Yahweh, may your armies help us out of this situation.
verses.16: And the LORD said, “Because they have exalted themselves above their mothers. Their steps are full of deceitfulness; their eyes are deceitful. They walk in darkness, and their feet will be trampled.”
verses.17: And Adonai, the king of Zion’s children, will destroy them. And Jehovah will destroy their forests.
verses.18: On that day, he will remove the decorations from the idols and the idols themselves.
verses.20: The prophets and the pilgrims, and those who are in deep thought and meditation.
verses.21: The leaves and flowers of the rose bush.
verses.22: The wrappers, covers, and coversings, as well as the markings.
verses.23: And the gillions and the seditious ones, and the traitors and the deceivers.
verses.24: And beneath their cover will be a place of darkness; beneath their covering will be a place of gloom. And beneath their actions will be a place of hardness and coldness. And beneath their prison will be a place of darkness, just as it is beneath Yophi.
verses.25: In the time of destruction, they will fall; but your kingdom will endure in the midst of war.
verses.26: And we shall open her gates, and she shall be set upon the earth.
